summary: c1 was introduced: the before decoder supported only framed input; the after decoder supports magicless frames when explicitly configured, but the fixed harness never selects that format.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established that magicless streaming decompression belongs to this target’s supported operational surface.

before.requirement: Decode magicless frames by selecting the magicless format on the stream.
before.reason: The before decoder required the standard frame magic and had no format field or ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat implementation for this route.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before decoder context has no format state to select magicless parsing.
The reconstructed before file has no ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat definition.

after.requirement: Select ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless on the same DStream before streaming decompression of a magicless frame.
after.reason: The new contract requires explicit format selection. Creation defaults to standard format, and the harness only initializes, resets, and decodes; its bytes cannot select the format.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: This setter stores the selected format on the decoder context before decoding.
Stream creation initializes the decoder to the standard format.
The stream header parser requires the selected magicless format to bypass the standard magic check.
Streaming decompression passes the context format to the parser and returns its header error.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The seed helper consumes prefix bytes; the remaining bytes are supplied to the fixed stream decoding path.

claims.comparison_reason: The same old harness is assessed on both sides. Its missing format setter blocks a newly supported route after the change; before the change, that route was not supported.
